easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
